text:
Nina: preflight eval (prompt-suite PS-2026-03-21-2) flagged a regression on reranker. Need quick call: full hold or surgical pin?

DeployBot: PRE-FLIGHT SUMMARY:
- suite: ps-2026-03-21-2
- failures: 22/500 (4.4%) > gate 2%
- routes affected: reranker, search-assist; other routes OK
- metric: rerank_mismatch +6.8% vs baseline
- suggestion: partial pin or revert prompt change T-11

Ravi: T-11 was meant to improve recall for multi-hop queries. Author @Tess — can you confirm changes?

Tess: yes, T-11 relaxed anchor constraints. I can revert but would prefer pin so we don't delay the whole deploy.

QA-Bot: narrow-run by prompt-template complete. T-11 is responsible for 70% of failures in reranker samples.

Maya: change window closes in 2 hours (20:00 PT). If we pin per-route, ops needs 30m lead to run canary smoke.

Nina: I'm leaning to pin reranker to v2026.4 (previous) and let rest of v2026.5 go. That keeps security fixes and infra changes in today.

Infra: per-route pin supported. Command: `deploybot set-pin --route reranker --from v2026.5 --to v2026.4 --reason "prompt T-11 regression"`

Tess: I'll open PR to revert T-11 and include unit prompts. Will notify QA for re-eval tomorrow.

Ravi: product ok with partial pin? @Maya

Maya: product accepts partial pin. Update release_notes with one-liner and create a follow-up to backfill telemetry.

DeployBot: ACTIONS CREATED:
- ticket REL-5234: reranker pinned to v2026.4 (owner Nina)
- ticket PROMPT-312: revert T-11 and add testcases (owner Tess)
- smoke check scheduled 19:45 PT (Infra)

Nina: executing pin now.

DeployBot: PIN APPLIED at 1765439998. reranker -> v2026.4.

Infra: starting smoke in us-west.

DeployBot: SMOKE: latencies nominal; reranker correctness quick-sweep pass.

Maya: proceeding with remaining changes. Tess please trigger re-eval when PR is merged.

Tess: will merge revert after CI. Thanks all.

Nina: marking release as "partial-accept — gated until prompt revert validated" and closing this thread.
